name: write_phase_summary
description: Call this tool at the conclusion of every build phase. It generates a structured markdown summary of what was built, verified, and installed. Do not proceed to the next phase until the orchestrator approves this summary.

phase_number.description: The number of the completed phase (1-7).

files_created.description: List of all files created or significantly modified during this phase.

verification_results.description: A clear PASS/FAIL report of the steps verified in the browser or via API.

notes.description: Any deviations from the original plan or potential issues encountered.
